description: Pre-existing at 0018c110a (verified in a pristine worktree build). Repro: fn main() do NL xs = [1,2,3,4,5] NL range = 1..5 NL dbg(Enum.take(xs, 3)) NL end -- fz2 interp fails with: backend executable 11 function 65 entry 0 step evaluation failed: backend value 0 is unbound. Removing the unused range binding makes it pass. Possibly related to the historical enum_take_drop_split matrix reds (fz-go4.22). Not caused by and not fixed by the fz-9i4.7.10.2 row model.
title: interp: 'backend value 0 is unbound' on Enum.take(xs, 3) beside an unused range binding
